name: Salt Lake Mahjong Club
description: Beginner two-night course (Mahjong 101 & 102) and open play nights in the Salt Lake City area. Official site quote: "Bring your NMLJ card and enjoy an evening of practice, laughter, and connection." (site spells NMJL as 'NMLJ'). Venues and dates are booked via the club's scheduling page; none were visible when checked.
schedule: Mahjong 101 & 102 classes and regular open play nights; book at saltlakemahjongclub.as.me (dates not visible on page)

name: Pittsfield Township Senior Center Mahjong
description: Weekly Tuesday mahjong at the Pittsfield Township Senior Center (Ann Arbor Observer listing: free, all levels welcome). The listing does not say American / NMJL; style unconfirmed.
address: 701 W. Ellsworth Rd, Ann Arbor, MI

name: Ann Arbor Mahjong Club
description: Traveling instructors teach private/group mahjong lessons in Washtenaw County (Ann Arbor, Brighton, Canton, Chelsea, Dexter, Howell, Plymouth, Saline). Site says lessons cover 'the tiles, card, Charleston, and fundamentals' but does not explicitly say American / NMJL.
schedule: Classic 2-hour lesson $85/player (1-3 players), $75/player (4+); Signature Soiree 3-hour $100/$85; book via site

name: The Velvet Wind
description: Asheville's first dedicated mahjong lounge with open play and workshops for all levels. Site (via automated page read) says instructors are certified by the School of American Mahjong and NMJL cards are provided; the workshops page itself did not repeat this, so a human should confirm.
schedule: Open play Wed-Thu 10 AM-9 PM and Fri-Sat 12-9 PM in 2-hour blocks ($15/seat regular table; $20 automatic table)
